page.overview:
Who is Askroh?

Askroh was a crime lord who lived in Cloud City on the planet Bespin. He assisted Lando Calrissian with a plan to scare Jiandy out of his dream for a life in crime.

He was interrogating the Ugnaught Tudd for smuggling Alderaanian white behind his back when Jiandy stole his brooch. He and his henchman caught them, but Calrissian and Jiandy managed to hop onto a repulsor cargo crate to escape. Askroh and his men chased them and managed to corner them by the docking bay. Askroh ordered his men to throw them out of the city when Lando revealed where Jiandy was hiding his brooch. Jiandy ran off, saying he never wanted to see Calrissian again.

After Jiandy ran off, Askroh mentioned that his man had given him a note asking for help with the plan. Lando asked what Askroh would do if he had the choice. This made Askroh very angry, and Calrissian soon left.
